IdeoPresetDef.label: closed society
IdeoPresetDef.description: People come first, and our people are everything. We must not allow contact with others.

IdeoPresetDef.label: high society
IdeoPresetDef.description: Etiquette, ceremonies and a baguette lifestyle, as well as personal success, are the main meaning.

IdeoPresetDef.label: torchbearers
IdeoPresetDef.description: Light is the center of our universe, no matter whether it is sunlight or the fire of burned villages.

IdeoPresetDef.label: fallen xenophobes
IdeoPresetDef.description: Our ancestors were weak and fell to the xenos scum. We can't do this again!

IdeoPresetDef.label: bloody usurpers
IdeoPresetDef.description: Bloody rituals, lavish banquets and feasts during the plague.
